title: plugin-selection-audit: artefacts and verification pipeline for “Large per-window oracle headroom that three selector families did not convert”
description:
Complete replication package for the manuscript Large per-window oracle headroom that three selector families did not convert: a feedback-delay audit of plug-in selection for time series forecasting.

Contents: the training grid and per-run artefacts; per-window oracle-headroom decompositions; the feedback-delay (lead-time) audit; the robustness sweeps over metric, aggregation and block-filtering choices; the selector implementations and their evaluation; and a test suite covering the analysis code. tools/verify_paper_numbers.py re-derives all 204 quantitative claims of the manuscript from the released artefacts and fails on any mismatch.
